status.description:
Canonical lifecycle state derived from the states parameter. This is the single source
of truth for the entity's current lifecycle position. Consumed by Colorized to resolve
visual tokens, and by view extensions to render StatusBadge and StatusTimeline.

state_history.description:
Chronological log of state transitions. Each entry records the before/after states,
timestamp, and (when governance is enabled) the actor, reason, and transition metadata.
Rendered by StatusTimeline in the detail and timeline views.

Entry structure:
  - from: string (previous state)
  - to: string (new state)
  - timestamp: ISO 8601 datetime
  - actor_id: string (user/system who triggered the transition, optional)
  - reason: string (human-readable justification, required when requireTransitionReason is true)
  - transition_metadata: Record<string, unknown> (arbitrary context, optional)

allowed_transitions.description:
Materialized list of valid next states from the current status, computed from the
transitionRules parameter. When transitionRules is null (open model), this contains
all states except the current one. Used by StatusSelector to disable invalid options
and by StatusBadge to indicate available paths.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the entity was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the most recent modification, when available.

last_event.description: Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.

last_event_at.description: Timestamp for the lifecycle event captured in last_event.

tags.description: Ordered list of tags assigned to the entity.

tag_count.description: Computed number of tags assigned to the entity.

tag_metadata.description:
Per-tag governance metadata. Each entry corresponds to a tag in the tags array and
tracks provenance and usage for taxonomy health monitoring.

Entry structure:
  - tag: string (the tag value, matches entry in tags array)
  - created_at: ISO 8601 datetime
  - created_by: string (user ID or "system" for allow-list tags)
  - usage_count: number (how many entities use this tag, computed)
  - moderation_status: "approved" | "pending" | "rejected" (when allowTagModeration is true)
  - canonical_form: string (resolved synonym target, when synonymResolution is enabled)

address_roles.description: Ordered list of roles that currently have address entries.

default_address_role.description: Role surfaced in UI contexts when one address must be highlighted.

addresses.description: Collection of { role, address, metadata } entries keyed by role.

preference_document.description: Normalized preference payload captured by PreferenceStore (version, preferences map, metadata).

preference_metadata.description: Tracks schema version, lastUpdated timestamp, migration records, and source.

preference_version.description: SemVer mirror of preference_document.version for indexing and analytics.

preference_namespaces.description: Materialized namespace list resolved from parameters/registry for auditing.

preference_mutations.description: Monotonic counter incremented whenever preferences mutate (invalidates caches).

membership_records.description: SaaS membership triple (user_id, organization_id, role_id) with UNIQUE constraint (TABLE 4).

role_hierarchy_edges.description: Parent→child adjacency list for hierarchical RBAC (Part 3.1).

session_roles.description: Materialized roles granted within the current session/token exchange.

template_catalog.description: Localized template definitions with declared variables per R20.1 Part 2.3.

messages.description: Atomic message payloads queued for delivery (R20.6 Part 1.2 primitives).

conversations.description: Multi-party threaded conversations with membership metadata (R20.6 Part 3.3).

message_statuses.description: Delivery state machine transitions (queued → sent → delivered → failed → retried → read).

user_id.description: Primary identifier used to correlate identity across services.

name.description: Human-friendly name rendered in headers and list contexts.

preferred_name.description: Preferred display name surfaced in collaborative tooling.

description.description: Supporting summary rendered in detail and card contexts.

primary_email.description: Canonical login email address for the user.

role.description: Highest privilege role currently granted to the user.

timezone.description: Preferred timezone applied when rendering timestamps.
